original: Corrija: How many boxs do those two persons have?
correcao: Corrija boxs para boxes e use o plural cotidiano people no lugar de persons: How many boxs do those two persons have?

original: Cross the street! The museum is ___ our hotel.
correcao: Indique explicitamente que o museu fica do outro lado da rua em relação ao hotel: Cross the street! The museum is ___ our hotel.

original: — ___ a supermarket near your apartment? — Yes, there's one right next to the bank.
correcao: Pergunte pela existência de um supermercado usando there: — ___ a supermarket near your apartment? — Yes, there's one right next to the bank.

original: — Is there a supermarket near your apartment? — Yes, ___ one right next to the bank.
correcao: Complete com a contração de there is: — Is there a supermarket near your apartment? — Yes, ___ one right next to the bank.

original: — Is there a supermarket near your apartment? — Yes, there's one right ___ the bank.
correcao: Complete com next to (ao lado de): — Is there a supermarket near your apartment? — Yes, there's one right ___ the bank.

original: ___ twenty people waiting at the reception desk.
correcao: Complete com a construção afirmativa de existência there + be no presente: ___ twenty people waiting at the reception desk.

original: There are twenty people waiting ___ the reception desk.
correcao: Complete com at para indicar o ponto de atendimento: There are twenty people waiting ___ the reception desk.

original: — ___ any messages for me on my phone? — No, there aren't any.
correcao: Pergunte pela existência de mensagens usando there: — ___ any messages for me on my phone? — No, there aren't any.

original: — Are there any messages for me on my phone? — No, ___ any.
correcao: Complete com a negativa contraída de there are: — Are there any messages for me on my phone? — No, ___ any.

original: The printer is ___ the desk, between the computer and the lamp.
correcao: A impressora está apoiada sobre a mesa. Complete a preposição: The printer is ___ the desk, between the computer and the lamp.

original: The printer is on the desk, ___ the computer and the lamp.
correcao: Use between para indicar os dois pontos de referência: The printer is on the desk, ___ the computer and the lamp.

original: Look across the avenue: ___ a beautiful park right across from our office building.
correcao: Complete com a contração afirmativa de there is: Look across the avenue: ___ a beautiful park right across from our office building.

original: Look across the avenue: there's a beautiful park right ___ our office building.
correcao: Complete com across from (do outro lado da avenida, em frente a): Look across the avenue: there's a beautiful park right ___ our office building.

original: ___ a subway station in my neighborhood, so I go to work by bus.
correcao: Diga que não existe estação de metrô, usando a negativa contraída de there is: ___ a subway station in my neighborhood, so I go to work by bus.

original: Sorry, I can't talk right now — I'm ___ the plane!
correcao: A pessoa é passageira a bordo do avião. Complete a preposição usual: Sorry, I can't talk right now — I'm ___ the plane!

original: Corrija: Has a good restaurant near the hotel?
correcao: Corrija a pergunta de existência usando Is there e mantendo near the hotel: Has a good restaurant near the hotel?

original: Corrija: In my street have many trees and two bakeries.
correcao: Reformule usando On my street no início (variante americana) e there are para a existência: In my street have many trees and two bakeries.

original: Corrija: My office is in the third floor, in Main Street.
correcao: Use on para o andar e on Main Street na variante americana: My office is in the third floor, in Main Street.

original: Corrija: I'm in the bus right now, looking at the map in my phone.
correcao: Reformule com on the bus para um passageiro a bordo e on my phone para a tela: I'm in the bus right now, looking at the map in my phone.

original: Corrija: Cross the avenue: the bank is in front of the subway station!
correcao: Substitua in front of por across from para explicitar que os lugares ficam em lados opostos da avenida: Cross the avenue: the bank is in front of the subway station!

original: Corrija: Don't have any free chairs in the meeting room.
correcao: Reescreva a ausência de cadeiras usando There aren't: Don't have any free chairs in the meeting room.

original: Sarah is talking to ___ husband on her phone.
correcao: O marido é da própria Sarah. Complete o possessivo: Sarah is talking to ___ husband on her phone.

original: This is ___ house; my mother and father love this street.
correcao: A casa pertence aos dois pais. Complete o possessivo plural: This is ___ house; my mother and father love this street.

original: Where is ___ report? I need it for the meeting.
correcao: Escolha a expressão com possessivo temporal ('s) que significa o relatório de hoje: Where is ___? I need it for the meeting.

original: Where is ___?
correcao: Escolha a construção compacta com kitchen modificando door, sem of: Where is ___?

original: My sister loves ___ job, and her husband works at the same bank.
correcao: Use o possessivo para o emprego da própria irmã: My sister loves ___ job, and her husband works at the same bank.

original: My sister loves her job, and ___ husband works at the same bank.
correcao: Use o possessivo para o marido da própria irmã: My sister loves her job, and ___ husband works at the same bank.

original: David forgot ___ umbrella, so I gave him mine.
correcao: O guarda-chuva pertence a David. Complete o possessivo: David forgot ___ umbrella, so I gave him mine.

original: We are in ___ meeting room. Where are the other teams? Are they in theirs?
correcao: Use o possessivo de we antes de meeting room: We are in ___ meeting room. Where are the other teams? Are they in theirs?

original: This is a photo of my two brothers and ___ wives.
correcao: As esposas são dos dois irmãos. Complete o possessivo: This is a photo of my two brothers and ___ wives.

original: The company is expanding ___ operations in Latin America.
correcao: Complete com o possessivo singular que retoma the company: The company is expanding ___ operations in Latin America.

original: Corrija: Julia is in Dublin with his boyfriend and your brother.
correcao: Reescreva deixando explícito que o namorado e o irmão são da própria Julia: Julia is in Dublin with his boyfriend and your brother.

original: Corrija: The car of my father is in the garage of my parents.
correcao: Reformule usando possessivo com apóstrofo: father é singular; parents indica os dois pais. The car of my father is in the garage of my parents.

original: We don't have ___ milk left in the fridge.
correcao: Escolha a forma neutra para negar a existência de qualquer quantidade de leite: We don't have ___ milk left in the fridge.

original: I only have ___ cash with me. Is there an ATM near here?
correcao: Complete com a little (uma pequena quantidade): I only have ___ cash with me. Is there an ATM near here?

original: — How many emails do you receive every day? — ___! Maybe a hundred a day.
correcao: Responda com A lot (duas palavras): — How many emails do you receive every day? — ___! Maybe a hundred a day.

original: Let me give you a ___ of advice: don't take too much luggage on a short trip!
correcao: Complete a expressão a piece of advice (um conselho): Let me give you a ___ of advice: don't take too much luggage on a short trip!

original: We only need ___ tomatoes (poucos) and a little olive oil (pouco) for the salad.
correcao: Escolha a few ou a little conforme o substantivo: We only need ___ tomatoes and a little olive oil for the salad.

original: We only need a few tomatoes (poucos) and ___ olive oil (pouco) for the salad.
correcao: Escolha a few ou a little conforme o substantivo: We only need a few tomatoes and ___ olive oil for the salad.

original: Could I have a ___ of water and two slices of bread, please?
correcao: Peça um copo (glass) de água: Could I have a ___ of water and two slices of bread, please?

original: Could I have a glass of water and two ___ of bread, please?
correcao: Peça duas fatias (slices) de pão: Could I have a glass of water and two ___ of bread, please?

original: — Do you have ___ news about the project? — Yes, I have some great news!
correcao: Escolha some ou any para a pergunta neutra sobre a existência de notícias: — Do you have ___ news about the project? — Yes, I have some great news!

original: — Do you have any news about the project? — Yes, I have ___ great news!
correcao: Complete com some na resposta afirmativa: — Do you have any news about the project? — Yes, I have ___ great news!

original: Hurry up! We don't have ___ time before the presentation starts.
correcao: Escolha much ou many para a quantidade de tempo: Hurry up! We don't have ___ time before the presentation starts.

original: She speaks English very well, and she only makes ___ mistakes.
correcao: Escolha a few ou a little para uma pequena quantidade de erros: She speaks English very well, and she only makes ___ mistakes.

original: Corrija: I need some informations about the hotel, and can you give me an advice?
correcao: Corrija os dois incontáveis usando some information e some advice: I need some informations about the hotel, and can you give me an advice?

original: Corrija: We don't have some bread, so I'm going to buy two breads at the bakery.
correcao: Corrija a negativa com any e substitua two breads por two bread rolls (dois pãezinhos): We don't have some bread, so I'm going to buy two breads at the bakery.
